title: Document host Bluetooth 6LoWPAN/IPSP tooling requirements
description: Document what host-side tooling is required to use BLE IPSP/6LoWPAN as a local-client transport. Cover Linux bluetooth_6lowpan kernel module, BlueZ configuration, macOS limitations, Windows BLE stack capabilities. Determine whether host tooling complexity favors or disfavors IPSP versus the SLIP-over-GATT approach.
